data.name: Blooming in Budbury
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Budbury!

It’s a picturesque medieval town where the birds sing, the cobblestone streets are clean, and the local apothecary is running the most beloved artisanal business in the duchy. That’s you.

Blooming in Budbury is a shop-management and farming simulator where you supply the town with exactly what it needs to take the edge off. You’ll start your days as a humble merchant selling basic health potions, but it won't take long before you discover the real money is in Budbury's thriving, completely legal "chill" economy. From innocent potion-crafter to the realm's premier botanist, it's time to let your business bloom!

Peak Shop Keeping Experience

Keep the town running by stocking your shelves with magical remedies and botanical delights. Cure the lumberjack's insomnia, supply the local wizard with mana, and ring up the day's profits.

  • Immersive Management: No boring menus here. Order wholesale goods by sending off your trusty messenger pigeon from the back room.

  • The Tally Desk: Sort your customers' purchases and pack them into satisfying, heavy wicker baskets before sending them on their way.

  • Stock the Shelves: Balance your inventory to make sure you have enough Minor Health Potions for the peasant militia and Huge Mana Potions for the local spellcasters.

Budbury's Finest Cash Crop

When the shop closes, head to your private garden to cultivate the town's most requested goods. It's a perfectly legal, highly celebrated local trade!

  • Farm Your Greenery: Plant, water, and harvest a variety of exotic herbs, relaxing flora, and magical mushrooms.

  • Craft the Good Stuff: Process your harvest to roll everything from a Regular Chill Stick for a stressed peasant on their lunch break to an Extraordinary Chill Stick that will make the user speak with the old gods.

  • Serve the Community: Everyone from the local baker to the off-duty guardsman is a paying customer looking for your finest blends.

High Society Clients

Step out from behind the counter and explore the entire 3D city of Budbury to meet your key clientele. The villagers aren't just faceless wallets; they have specific needs, deep pockets, and special requests for a master botanist like you.

  • Supply the Mad Wizard with mind-bending brews and psychedelic mushrooms.

  • Keep the Captain of the Guard relaxed with a steady supply of his favorite uncommon smokes.

  • Build relationships with the Priest, the Lumberjack, the Blacksmith, and more!

Can you balance the books, tend to your crops, and keep the realm buzzing?

data.short_description: Set up shop in the peaceful medieval town of Budbury! Brew potions, manage your ledger, and chat with the locals. But behind the counter? You're building a highly lucrative underground botanical empire. Farm herbs, roll premium "chill sticks," and become the realm's top supplier.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 2070 (8 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (8 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (12 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
